title: P115 and the Number of the Beast (Tyndale Bulletin 58.1, 151-53)
author: P. J. Williams
summary: Short note on the 616 reading of Revelation 13:18 in P115 (P.Oxy. 4499): grants that 616 has been used to support the Nero reading and proposes that the numeral may also visually mimic abbreviations for Jesus' name.

title: Number of the beast
author: Encyclopaedia Britannica editors
summary: Reference article on 666: notes that the Hebrew transliteration Neron Qesar is the most common gematria reading and that an Oxyrhynchus papyrus fragment reads 616.

title: Daniel and the Revelation
author: Uriah Smith
summary: Classic Seventh-day Adventist historicist exposition: the sea beast as the papacy, the land beast as the United States, and the three angels of Revelation 14 as the advent message of the 1840s onward.

title: Revelation: A New Translation with Introduction and Commentary (Anchor Yale Bible 38A)

title: Imperial Cults and the Apocalypse of John: Reading Revelation in the Ruins
author: Steven J. Friesen
summary: Archaeological and textual study of the imperial cults of Roman Asia (Pergamum, Smyrna, Ephesus) and how they illuminate John's critique of empire.

title: The Old Testament Pseudepigrapha (2 vols.)

summary: Standard English edition of Second Temple Jewish texts such as 1 Enoch, 4 Ezra, 2 Baruch, Jubilees, the Psalms of Solomon and the Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs, cited here for the Jewish background of Revelation's imagery.
